name: potpie
title: potpie.ai
shortDescription: Potpie transforms your codebase into a smart, AI-driven environment. It allows developers to build custom AI agents that understand their specific codebase and automate complex engineering tasks. By installing the VS Code extension, users can easily create and manage these agents directly within their editor. An example use case is automating bug fixes or code refactoring, which enhances productivity and reduces manual effort.
pros: Custom AI agents tailored to specific tasks
cons: May have a learning curve for building agents
